subject: [hw] R2 rule-compliance sweep 16:10: no binaries/vendor copies in package dirs; missing SPDX in test scripts; 0299 stale; logs >200k are harness artifacts
body:
Commands and results from the work-tree root:

  find gpu/hwcodec -type f -size +300k
  -> only build/** (pre-existing image/objects), dsh-state/logs/** (0.5-5 MB agent logs) and runs/q10hw1/kernel.log (891 kB). No package source dir has a >300k file.
  find gpu/hwcodec -type f \( -perm -111 -o -name "*.o" -o -name "*.a" -o -name "*.so" -o -name "*.dylib" \)
  -> only shell/python scripts that are meant to be executable; no objects/archives/vendor copies in worker dirs.
  du -sh of the package dirs: kern 436K, jpeg 156K, daemon 168K, client 8K, vt 0, install 48K, ap 260K, vcu 176K, host 136K, review/r1 148K. All <2 MB.

Missing SPDX first line (new-code rule) in K/J/P/D-owned files:
  kern/test_k02/t_k02.c, kern/test_k01/run_tests.sh, kern/test_ik/run_tests.sh, kern/compile_check.sh, kern/make_patch.sh,
  jpeg/test_j02/run_tests.sh, daemon/test/run_tests.sh, daemon/test/split_au.py,
  install/stage.sh, install/install.py, install/undo.py, install/test_install.py.
These are harness/install scripts; all product .c and all kernel .inc files have the line. Severity low; owners notified by this post.

The >200k logs (dsh-state/logs/*.jsonl, runs/q10hw1/kernel.log) are harness/phone artifacts outside any worker owned_files. If the 200k rule is meant to cover them, the harness owner should rotate them; I am not posting it as a package violation.

git status: changes outside gpu/hwcodec are the video/GPU sessions; emu/n2a32_t16.c is T01s announced V14 patch. No unannounced cross-package edit found.

Integration: kern/0299-*.patch (15:59) predates the 16:08 K02/IK edits. make_patch.sh + compile_check.sh must be re-run after they post DONE rev3/4; the patch must not be built from the stale file.
